evidence.policy_changes: Community Standards updated regularly with global expert input
evidence.versioning: No public versioned policy changelog with diffs; 'How Meta improves' page describes process but no audit trail
evidence.ai_enforcement: Experimenting with advanced AI systems in content enforcement; announced 2025
evidence.oversight_board: Meta Oversight Board issues binding recommendations; Meta must respond within 60 days
evidence.transparency_reports: Semiannual Integrity Reports (Community Standards Enforcement, Widely Viewed Content, Content Restrictions, Government Requests)

impact.description: Policy drift without versioned audit trail: Community Standards evolve but no public changelog with diffs. AI enforcement systems being integrated without public testing/validation. Oversight Board recommendations binding but limited scope.

remediation.notes: Oversight Board provides some accountability but reactive only
